chapter: Will Vodery and the road shows
title: On the road with 'Stopping the Traffic' and Dewey Wineglass
summary: Whaley toured with dancer-producer Dewey Wineglass, who was hospitalised six months after fighting Elks in Pittsburgh, so Whaley took charge of the show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And then I went on the road with Dewey Wineglass in Stopping the Traffic.
Who was Dewey Wineglass? Was he a white--
Where did he get the name of Wineglass?
I don't know. Anyway, -- didn't you know him?
I think I did know him.
Sure, he was up at the theater, you know. He used to dance the Russian dance.
Dewey Wineglass, he was a dancer, huh?
Yeah. And then he produced this show,

And we went -- where did we go? Not at Baltimore. Was it Baltimore we went? And he was made an Elk. And I told him to do everything they tell you, don't fight them. No, in Pittsburgh. That's right, in Pittsburgh. I said, don't fight him. Man, he started fighting them people and, man, they put him in the hospital for six months.
Yeah. And I had to take charge of the show, and we went on to Chicago, went to St. Louis, we come on back to Philadelphia.
No, this was Stopping the Traffic.
